title: Free Beginner ASL Workshop 'Let's Talk with Our Hands' Comes to PJ's Coffee Tuesday
excerpt: A free beginner American Sign Language workshop comes to PJ's Coffee, 1705 E. Del Mar Blvd., on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at 6 p.m., hosted with Sign & Social and Lulu Talks.
content:
Laredoans with no experience in American Sign Language can try it out for free on Tuesday night, as PJ's Coffee hosts a beginner workshop called "Let's Talk with Our Hands."

The session starts at 6 p.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at PJ's Coffee, 1705 E. Del Mar Blvd. It is led by Bianca of Sign & Social and Lulu Talks and is designed as an interactive, social introduction for people who have never signed before — no prior experience needed, just curiosity and a willingness to learn basic signs and meet new people, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The workshop is part of Lulu Talks' "Martes de Felicidad" series. Sign & Social is a Laredo community organization founded by Bianca Cubriel that runs social events and lessons focused on ASL and Deaf culture.

Spots are limited, and reservations are made by direct message to Lulu Talks on social media.
